GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2015-11-12T01:39:36Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Tests: no way ensuring that super has been called.
Description: When writing tests (using Jasmine in my case), how can one ensure that the super of a class is called?

For instance, in the following code:

```
class Snake extends Animal {
    constructor(name: string) { super(name); }
    move(meters = 5) {
        alert("Slithering...");
        super.move(meters);
    }
}
```

How can one write a test ensuring `super.move()` is called when `Snake.move()` is called?
